thread:
maya_marketing: Hey @sara_runtime @devon_runtime — quick ask for launch data. We need validated bench numbers and reproducible artifacts for the launch post + Wednesday webinar. Can you run a short, focused rerun and attach the raw CSVs and command used? :pray:

alex_marketing: What exactly do you need from runtime? p50/p95, throughput, config?

maya_marketing: Short list: p50/p95 latencies, tokens/sec (throughput), GPU memory, and total cost estimate for the run. For each model variant: 7B quantized (int8) and 13B quantized (int8) plus fp16 baseline. Two sequence lengths: 512 and 2048. Also embeddings latency for 512. We want median and 95th, plus sample traces for any outliers.

sara_runtime: Got it. We can run those. Two quick q's: (1) do you want these on Dedicated pool or Hosted under the current runtime image? Dedicated will give stable numbers. (2) Do you have the exact prompt set / seed so we can repro?

maya_marketing: Dedicated preferred if available — we need production-like SLOs. Prompt set is the marketing demo set (shared in /mnt/marketing/demo-prompts/2026-03-01.txt). Seed: 42. Also please include KV/prefix cache enabled vs disabled for the 2048 runs.

alex_marketing: Timing: can we get initial smoke CSVs by EOD Tuesday? Full artifacts (raw logs, perf CSVs, and the run script) by Wednesday 2pm PST for the webinar dry run.

devon_runtime: @maya_marketing noted. We have a recent kernel change that impacted long-sequence perf. I can try both current release and the last stable (release-2026-02-18) so you get a before/after comparison. Any objection?

maya_marketing: No objection — that's actually helpful. Please tag which kernel each run used in the CSV and include the git commit hash for the runtime + model weights revision.

sara_runtime: Plan: schedule 6 runs per model variant (cache on/off x seq len x kernel variant). We'll collect p50/p95, tokens/sec, GPU mem, and per-request logs. We'll upload CSVs to the marketing S3 bucket: s3://redwood-marketing/bench-launch/1843210987/.

ci-bot: bench-run scheduled: id=br-1843210987-1 queue=dedicated-pool-2 start=1843220000

devon_runtime: Quick note on methodology we will attach to the artifacts: - synthetic vs real prompt mix (we'll run both), - batch size=1 streaming path, - concurrency=8 to simulate production bursts, - temperature=0.0 deterministic generation. If you want batch=4 telemetry for throughput, say so now.

maya_marketing: Keep batch=1 for latency claims. We might add a small paragraph on batched throughput as an appendix, so do a secondary run with batch=4 if it's cheap.

sara_runtime: Understood. I'll also include the exact CLI we use. Example run command we'll record: 

```
./run_bench --model redwood/gpt-small-7b:int8 --seq 512 --cache on --batch 1 --concurrency 8 --seed 42 --output csv --commit 9f1b2a --kernel release-2026-02-18
```

sara_runtime: Two more things: (1) we'll flag any request >2x median as an outlier and attach the full stack trace; (2) for cost estimates we'll use current cloud GPU spot pricing snapshot (will include timestamped pricing file).

alex_marketing: Great. Can you also include human-readable notes like "safe to quote: p50=XXms, p95=YYms (512 tokens)" in a short summary file? Marketing will craft copy from that.

devon_runtime: Will do. One caveat: quantized weights for 13B in int8 still have slightly higher variance on 2048 sequences. We'll annotate uncertainty and include replication counts (n=6) so you can show error bars.

maya_marketing: Perfect. Please post the smoke CSVs to the Slack channel when ready (or paste a short snippet). If anything blocks, ping me. :rocket:
